_comment: Test set for the basic RAG prototype. expected_sources are substrings of source_file names that SHOULD appear in the top-k evidence. expected_status lists acceptable answer statuses (meaningful when an LLM is configured). expect_abstain=true means the system should NOT present a confident answer.
